data.gist: CFU-F assays plated 1×10^6 marrow mononuclear cells, counting colonies of ≥50 fibroblast-like cells after 14 days plus colorimetric quantification.
data.plain: To measure how many marrow cells could form stem-cell colonies, mononuclear cells were plated and grown for two weeks, then fixed and stained with crystal violet. Clusters of at least 50 fibroblast-like cells were counted as colonies and expressed per mL marrow or per 100,000 cells, with overall growth also read on a spectrophotometer.
